jobs.description:
Our client is the Belgian market leader in its sector, with a strong ambition to accelerate its international expansion.While recognized as a leading player in its industry, the company has maintained the agility, entrepreneurial spirit, and close-knit culture of an SME. With a team of approximately 20 professionals, success relies on individuals who combine ownership, initiative, and a willingness to contribute beyond the boundaries of a traditional job description.To support its continued growth and strengthen its internal organization, the company is looking for a Secretary General/Chief of Staff with a solid legal background and a strong operational mindset.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Secretary General acts as a trusted partner to the management team, ensuring that the company operates efficiently, compliantly, and in a structured manner.The role is ideally suited for someone with a background as a lawyer, in-house counsel, or legal professional, who enjoys combining legal rigor with operational involvement. You will be expected to move seamlessly between strategic, cross-functional topics and day-to-day execution.One hour you may be reviewing an important contractual matter, overseeing compliance obligations, or advising management on governance issues; the next, you may be coordinating an internal project, improving a process, organizing follow-up on key decisions, or liaising with external partners.We are looking for an individual who combines a helicopter view with a hands-on mentality, who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and executing pragmatically.Key ResponsibilitiesGovernance, Legal & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, internal policies, and corporate obligations.
• Support management in assessing legal and operational risks.
• Maintain a pragmatic and business-oriented approach to legal matters.
Operational Coordination & Business Support

• Organize internal meetings, monitor action plans, and drive accountability.
• Assist the CEO and management team with strategic and operational priorities.
• Facilitate communication and collaboration across teams and external stakeholders.
Process Improvement & Organizational Excellence

• Bring structure, clarity, and consistency to internal operations.
• Review and improve processes, workflows, and internal controls.
• Ensure that priorities are translated into tangible actions and results.
HR, Administration & Corporate Support

• Support HR administration, onboarding processes, and internal policies.
• Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
• Contribute to a positive, efficient, and well-organized working environment.
Finance & Corporate Administration

• Oversee administrative aspects of invoicing, reporting, and operational follow-up.
• Coordinate with external accountants and financial advisors.
• Ensure that recurring administrative and financial processes are properly managed and monitored.
External Stakeholder Management

• Coordinate relationships with external accountants, IT providers, insurers, and other professional partners.
• Ensure that external support functions are properly managed and aligned with business needs.

ProfileWe are looking for someone who:

• Holds a Master's degree in Law.
• Has approximately 5 years of professional experience, ideally as a lawyer, in-house counsel, legal advisor, or in a similar role combining legal and business responsibilities.
• Possesses a strong legal foundation and an interest in governance, compliance, and corporate organization.
• Combines analytical rigor with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.
• Enjoys alternating between strategic thinking and operational execution.
• Is highly organized, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
• Is proactive and comfortable taking ownership without requiring constant supervision.
• Thrives in an SME environment where flexibility, initiative, and entrepreneurial spirit are essential.
• Understands that in a team of 20 people, everyone contributes beyond their title and is willing to step outside their comfort zone when needed.
• Is fluent in Dutch, and English. French is a plus.

A leading international food manufacturer which operates in a fast-moving consumer goods environment and manages a portfolio of well-known consumer brands with strong market recognition.The organization places a strong emphasis on sustainability, quality, and consumer-centric strategies.In Belgium, it collaborates closely with major retailers, distributors, and foodservice partners to strengthen its market presence.

Jobomschrijving

The Key Account Manager FMCG will be in charge of the following responsibilities :

• Forecast sales accurately and manage account budgets effectively.
• Conduct regular business reviews with customers and present recommendations to drive growth.

As an Operator in Hot Kitchen Department, you are responsible for independently operating various production machines. In this department, ingredients and prepared products are fried, cooked, steamed, mixed, and boiled.

Your responsibilities include operating equipment such as cooking kettles, filling machines, mixers, and combi steam ovens. You also prepare dishes and food components in accordance with our quality, hygiene, and safety standards.

 

What does the job involve?

As a Kitchen Operator, you are the right-hand person of the Team Leader in the Hot Kitchen Department, supporting them in the production of prepared dishes and food components.

You are responsible for preparing and carrying out recipes. Your tasks include:

• Taking over the duties of kitchen staff in their absence.

• Carrying out the necessary quality checks on raw materials and preparing them for processing when required. Depending on the workload, you work together with kitchen staff, providing them with clear instructions and guidance to ensure that their tasks are carried out correctly.

• Independently following and executing recipes in accordance with quality standards and IFS requirements.

• Ensuring that industrial equipment is properly cleaned after and between each production run, in accordance with hygiene regulations.

• Preparing spice blends according to the recipes when the Goods Receiving employee is absent.

• Correctly preparing frozen ingredients and recipe components according to the production order.

• Labelling semi-finished products and recording their use in our computer system.

• Recording cooling temperatures.

Requirements:

• You have a very good command of Dutch (speaking, reading, writing, and understanding). A good knowledge of English and/or French is an advantage.

• You are comfortable with basic calculations, reading weights, and using weighing scales.

• You have completed training in a culinary field (institutional catering, chef, catering assistant, or butcher) or have equivalent experience.

• You are familiar with food safety regulations.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are flexible and enjoy the challenge of switching between different departments.

• You can work well under pressure. Things can get quite busy at Marblo! 

• You maintain a neat and well-groomed appearance. For hygiene and safety reasons, gel nails, excessive make-up, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted in our production areas.

Do you like working with machines and keeping production running smoothly?

As a Production Operator in the food industry, you play a key role in ensuring a stable, efficient and safe production process. You work in a modern production environment where teamwork, responsibility and quality matter.

• You start up, operate and adjust production machines throughout the shift.

• You monitor the production process and intervene when adjustments are needed.

• You troubleshoot minor technical issues and contact maintenance when necessary.

• You follow the production planning and keep the process running efficiently.

• You communicate clearly with fellow operators to ensure smooth collaboration.

• You help guarantee production continuity through good organisation and coordination.

• You handle basic administrative tasks related to production.

• You keep your workstation clean, organised and compliant with hygiene and safety rules.

• You have relevant experience as a production or machine operator.

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your process.

• You are hands-on, proactive and solution-oriented.

• You have basic technical insight and enjoy working with machines.

• You speak English fluently (no Dutch required for this role, Polish/Romanian is useful).

• You are willing to work in shifts, including early starts (from 3:30 AM) or a fixed afternoon shift.(A forklift certificate is a plus, but not required.)

Do you like to roll up your sleeves? 

And are you looking for a flexible job that fits your lifestyle?

Then SD Worx Jobs is the right place for you

Our client is going through a large-scale IT transformation. They're looking for an experienced Solution Architect who loves both the big picture and the technical detail, and who wants real impact in a technology leadership role.
What you'll do

• Design solutions that matter. You'll own end-to-end architecture for key IT initiatives, making sure they're robust, secure and fit for purpose

• Be the bridge. You'll connect Enterprise Architecture with the delivery teams, turning strategy into solutions that actually get built

• Team up. You'll work hand in hand with business owners, domain architects and engineers to deliver high-quality results

• Shape the roadmap. You'll define target architectures and roadmaps for a core business domain, using your hands-on experience

• Build for reuse. You'll create solution patterns and building blocks that other teams can rely on

• Share what you know. You'll lead communities of practice, exchange lessons learned with fellow architects and help the architecture practice grow

• 10+ years in IT, with solid experience as a Solution Architect on large transformation programmes

• Strong architecture skills: event-driven and service-based architectures, MicroServices, RESTful APIs

• Agile and DevOps experience at scale, including CI/CD. SAFe knowledge is a nice bonus

• A Togaf certification, or a similar one

• Tech you've worked with: .NET, Angular, Azure, Kafka, SQL, BPM/low-code platforms, Mainframe backends and SaaS packages

• The ability to zoom in and out: you're as comfortable writing a strategy document as solving an implementation challenge

• A pragmatic mindset: you go for what works, not what looks perfect on paper

• Autonomy and sharp analytical skills: you break down complex problems across teams and locations and come up with actionable answers

• Strong communication skills: you can convince project teams and senior management alike

• A mentor's spirit: you enjoy helping newer architects grow

• Fluent English

 

Nice to have

• Experience in financial services and its regulatory environment

• Knowledge of capital markets

• Familiarity with frameworks like Open Agile Architecture

jobs.occupation: g2 Recruitment Solutions - Life Sciences Transformation - Business Analyst
jobs.description:
• Location: Antwerp, Belgium (Hybrid)

• Language: English

• Start Date: December

• Industry: Life Sciences / Healthcare

• Engagement: Freelance

Our client, a leading European Life Sciences & Healthcare organisation, is embarking on a large-scale IT, Cloud & Business Transformation Programme aimed at modernising core business applications, streamlining operational processes, and accelerating their cloud journey.

As the programme enters a critical delivery phase, they are looking for a highly hands-on Senior Business Analyst who can bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technology teams, driving requirements definition, process optimisation, and transformation initiatives across multiple workstreams.

This is not a documentation-only role. We are looking for someone who enjoys being Embedded within the business, challenging existing ways of working, facilitating workshops, and actively shaping future-state solutions.
Responsibilities

• Engage with business and technical stakeholders to understand current-state processes and system landscapes.

• Lead requirements gathering workshops across multiple departments.

• Analyse and document complex business processes, identifying inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.

• Develop current-state and future-state process MAPS.

• Define and document business, functional and non-functional requirements.

• Translate business requirements into actionable functional specifications.

• Work closely with solution architects, developers, project managers and integration teams throughout project delivery.

• Support cloud migration and application transformation initiatives.

• Conduct gap analyses between legacy systems and future-state solutions.

• Facilitate stakeholder alignment and decision-making workshops.

• Support testing activities including UAT planning, execution and defect management.

• Track requirements through implementation to ensure business objectives are achieved.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across business and technology functions.

• 7+ years' experience as a Business Analyst within complex enterprise environments.

• Proven experience working on large-scale IT transformation programmes.

• Strong background in business process analysis and optimisation.

• Experience gathering and managing requirements across multiple stakeholder groups.

• Demonstrated experience working on cloud transformation, digital transformation, ERP, CRM or systems integration projects.

• Ability to challenge stakeholders constructively and influence decisions.

• Strong workshop facilitation skills.

• Experience operating in Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery environments.

• Excellent communication skills with both business and technical audiences.

Preferred experience:

• Experience within Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Healthcare or Medical Devices industries.

• Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or GCP.

• Experience supporting application migration or modernisation programmes.

• Understanding of regulated environments and compliance requirements.

• Knowledge of data migration, integration projects or enterprise application landscapes.

Key skills:

• Business Analysis

• Requirements Engineering

• Process Mapping

• BPMN

• Stakeholder Management

• Workshop Facilitation

• Gap Analysis

• Systems Integration

• Cloud Transformation

• Agile Methodologies

• User Stories

• Functional Specifications

• UAT Management

• Change Management

Our client is a well-established international financial services organization with a strong local presence in Belgium. To support its continued growth and digital transformation, they are looking for an IT Coordinator who will act as the key liaison between the local business, international IT teams, and external technology partners.This is a highly visible role offering a balanced mix of operational service management, stakeholder engagement, governance, and project delivery. Rather than being a hands-on technical expert, you will ensure that IT services are delivered efficiently, compliantly, and in line with both local business needs and international standards.

Jobomschrijving

Application & Service Management

• Act as the primary point of contact for business applications.
• Coordinate IT service delivery throughout the entire lifecycle, including incidents, changes, releases, and performance management.
• Oversee and monitor Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) processes.
• Manage external suppliers, including service levels, contracts, costs, quality, and performance.
• Facilitate collaboration between business stakeholders, international IT teams, and service providers to deliver sustainable and effective solutions.
• Ensure accurate documentation and compliance with group IT governance and control frameworks.
IT Infrastructure, Network & Digital Workplace

• Coordinate infrastructure and digital workplace services in partnership with international IT teams and external vendors.
• Monitor the quality and availability of workplace technologies, including hardware, networking, and telephony services.
• Oversee incident management processes and ensure timely escalation to the appropriate teams.
• Support the alignment of global IT standards and processes with local operational requirements.
• Represent the local organization within international IT communities and initiatives.
Project Management & Product Ownership

• Coordinate and follow up on IT projects involving internal stakeholders and external partners.
• Translate business requirements into practical IT solutions, acting as the bridge between local business needs and the central IT roadmap.
• Ensure successful implementation and delivery of technology solutions within agreed timelines and scope.
• Manage project scope, planning, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with international colleagues and key stakeholders.
• Identify opportunities for process optimization, innovation, and service improvement.
IT Governance, Compliance & Administration

• Monitor IT-related expenditures, invoices, and budgets.
• Contribute to IT risk and control frameworks, including regulatory requirements such as DORA, GDPR, and MiFID II.
• Ensure IT services comply with internal policies and external regulatory obligations.
• Monitor and continuously improve IT processes within the local business environment.
• Serve as a point of contact for audits and compliance-related activities.
• Support Business Continuity initiatives through planning, testing, and safeguarding critical business processes.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through relevant experience.
• At least 5 years of experience in an IT-related role.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft technologies, including SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Word, and Excel.
• Understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments is considered an asset.
• Strong service-oriented mindset with the ability to coordinate and drive initiatives forward.
• Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
• Able to connect people, facilitate collaboration, and navigate across different levels of an organization.
• Strong organizational and administrative skills with great attention to detail.
• Quality-driven with a focus on service continuity and operational excellence.
• Strong communication and teamwork skills.
• Fluent in Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a strong advantage.

BPYP Consultancy supports companies with recruitment and selection. For our client, a growing machine builder in the South-East Flanders region, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer.
 

Your role
 

You play a pivotal role in transforming innovative machine concepts into reliable, high-performance electrical systems. As the technical owner of the electrical design, you bridge project requirements and practical implementation, making sure every machine is engineered to the highest quality and safety standards.
 

Electrical design and project planning
 
 

• From the conceptual phase onwards, you take part in project design meetings with multidisciplinary engineering teams

Execution and collaboration

Practical
 
 

• Full-time, permanent contract 
 

• A master's degree in industrial sciences (electromechanics or electrotechnics), or equivalent experience 

• At least 5 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably in machine building 

• Solid knowledge of electrical standards; knowledge of UL standards is a plus 

• Good knowledge of Eplan P8; Eplan Pro Panel is a plus 

• An analytical mind and a problem solver 

• A good communicator and team player in an international environment 

• Good knowledge of English and Dutch
